scope: Independent review of generated INGEST implementation after each of I1, I2 and I3; I3 includes the complete aggregate review.
review_mode: Fresh-context, independent, read-only seats using the same frozen candidate, authority manifest, criteria and evidence. No builder reasoning or peer verdicts in the brief. Use the repository council workflow; disclose unavailable models and stop instead of substituting unasked.

gates.scope: Complete I1 foundations and all affected existing consumers/regressions; retain additive staging and unchanged legacy preparation/cache behavior. Do not require I2/I3 functionality early.

Complete I2 consumer adoption plus cumulative I1 compatibility, configuration, store admission/recovery, roles, failure/task observability and baseline/replacement positives and refusals. Do not require unbuilt I3 document features.

Complete I3 extraction/chunking/command/headless/process behavior plus full I1-I3 implementation, installed profiles, all affected package consumers, retained/replacement coverage and authored architecture/guides.
gates.blocks: human UAT and proposal of implementation completion

evidence_before_dispatch: Stable base/candidate commits and exact cumulative/slice diffs; clean candidate scope and declared unrelated dirty exclusions
Approved directive, impact, current dispositions, exact source/test maps and this council plan, with paths/revisions/hashes
Slice-specific acceptance criteria, positive/negative/regression/integration and normal/optimized evidence, command results and known baseline debt
Declared private installed environments, artifact/origin and asset identities, disposable store/readback evidence and preservation receipts as applicable
Traceable test changes and substantive authored-document validation due at this slice; distinguish inspected receipts from reproduced checks
Per-seat criteria table, cited source/evidence, exact score calculation, mandatory/advisory findings and limitations
review_focus: Implemented contracts, package ownership and reusable Chat/CLI/Runtime/TUI boundaries
Cross-package embedding/configuration compatibility and truthful failure/partial-effect behavior
Real document-to-chunks-to-Memory behavior, limits, configured guards and existing text consumers when due
Worker responsiveness, cancellation/timeout/shutdown and destination/cache/store/recovery identity when due
Meaningful retained/replacement tests, installed profiles, dependency effects and substantive user/architecture documentation

remediation.scope: Numbered findings within the approved construction scope; no opportunistic subsystem rewrite or baseline-debt cleanup.
remediation.review_after_change: Commit a stable corrected candidate. New fresh seats assess the approved remediation delta first, then full bounded aggregate conformance for that gate. No carry-forward verdict for changed bytes.
remediation.counting: A started pass counts even if a seat is incomplete, BLOCKED or fails protocol. No hidden replacement/reissue, extra pass or budget reset. Each gate has its own non-transferable cap.
remediation.after_third_unsuccessful_pass: Stop for Chuck with unresolved findings and exact candidate/evidence; do not advance the next slice or start another council.
remediation.material_expansion: Stop and obtain disposition before changes outside the approved scope/effects. Ordinary within-scope correction and review cycles do not need repeated permission.

effects.council_model_calls: Authorized only for the three named seats and bounded implementation gates after Git handoff/phase activation. No calls now.
effects.validation: Approved private offline execution profile only; owned local fixture servers where named. No production mutation, real embedding provider requests or live Finance tests.
effects.completed_vendor_evaluation: Reuse established Docling/readiness evidence. Do not restart vendor evaluation, archive re-audits or a historical AST-inventory campaign as a substitute for reviewing implementation.
effects.publication_and_acceptance: No push, merge, release, deployment or human product acceptance follows from a council verdict. UAT/effects and delivery remain separate.

prerequisites: Settle the requested Git handoff before coding
Commit and bind the approved document digests, then record the actual coding branch/base
Record each eligible phase's exact private execution binding before effects
Complete that phase's implementation and required builder checks before its council
